description: List startup funding events for the selected period. Dates use UTC detection time (created_at), not announcement time. The server recomputes calendar ranges on every request; UTC midnight can change the range between page requests. For a fixed date or custom date range, use period custom with explicit inclusive date_from and date_to (equal for a single day). Use period all_time for all available events. For rolling windows such as 'last 24 hours', 'last 7 days', or 'last 30 days', use period custom to query the UTC dates spanning the window, then filter created_at to the exact timestamps. Company search (q), date ranges, stage, currency, and amount bounds combine with AND; newest detections first. page starts at 1 (default 1); page_size defaults to 25 (1-100); the offset (page - 1) × page_size must be at most 10000. total counts all matching events, including those beyond the offset limit. To reach older matches, narrow dates with period custom. Repeated requests for the same page and filters may reuse its items and total for up to 30 seconds. Pages can reflect different snapshots. As the feed changes, events may repeat or be skipped across pages, and total may change. Each page or retry consumes MCP rate-limit quota per anonymous IP or authenticated account, separate from the public API quota. Successful and failed calls log their arguments and status for usage tracking. Anonymous access is available, with optional Authorization: Bearer <MCP token>. On HTTP 429, retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.

amount_max.description: Inclusive maximum round amount in whole units of each event's reported currency. Omit for an open upper bound. Must be at least amount_min when both are supplied. Applying an amount bound excludes events with unknown amounts. Currency conversion is unavailable.

amount_min.description: Inclusive minimum round amount in whole units of each event's reported currency. Omit for an open lower bound. Applying an amount bound excludes events with unknown amounts. Currency conversion is unavailable.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, such as USD or EUR, ignoring case. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed; blank values are ignored. Combine with amount_min and/or amount_max to compare amounts in that currency. Currency conversion is unavailable.

date_from.description: Earliest UTC detection date (created_at), inclusive, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required for period custom and forbidden for all other periods.

date_to.description: Latest UTC detection date (created_at), inclusive, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required for period custom and forbidden for all other periods. Must be on or after date_from.

page.description: Page number starting at 1. Increment to fetch the next page with the same filters. The offset (page - 1) × page_size must be at most 10000.

page_size.description: Maximum number of events to return per page.

period.description: UTC detection period: today starts at 00:00 UTC; this_week runs from Monday through today; this_month runs from the first day of the month through today. The server calculates calendar bounds per request. custom requires date_from and date_to; all_time has no date bounds. Date fields are forbidden for every period except custom.

q.description: Search company names or domains for a literal substring, ignoring case. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed; blank values are ignored.

stage.description: Funding stage: pre_seed, angel, seed, series_a, series_b, series_c, series_d, series_e, other. Case-insensitive. Spaces and hyphens can replace underscores. Blank values are ignored.

name: get_funding_events

items.description: Funding events on this page, newest detection first. An empty page returns an empty array.

company_linkedin_url.description: Company LinkedIn page URL. Null when unavailable.

company_name.description: Name of the company receiving funding.

company_website_url.description: Company website or domain. Null when unavailable.

created_at.description: When Tada Signals recorded the funding signal, in UTC.

event_type.description: Type of the signal, always funding.

funding_amount.description: Round amount in whole units of funding_currency. Null when the amount is unknown.

funding_currency.description: Reported currency of funding_amount, such as USD or EUR. Null when the currency is unknown.

funding_stage.description: Reported funding stage, such as seed or series_a. Null when the stage is unknown.

id.description: Unique identifier of the funding signal.

page_size.description: Maximum number of events on this page.

total.description: Number of events matching the filters across all pages.
